        if len(adj[i]) >= 4:
            good[i] = True
            has_good = True

    # Use bytearray for a fast and memory-efficient visited array

issues: `edges` list is populated but never used, which unnecessarily consumes memory and time.
The `deg` array is created but only used immediately to construct the `good` array; this can be optimized into a single step to avoid an extra pass and save memory.
`setrecursionlimit` is imported from `sys` but never used, as the DFS is implemented iteratively.
The check `if best == 0:` at the end is redundant because `best` will always be at least 1 if the code passes the `if not any(good[1:]):` early exit condition.

For $N < 5$, the graph cannot contain an alkane (the smallest alkane has 1 internal node and 4 leaves, totaling 5 vertices). An early exit condition `if N < 5:` can be added to skip graph building entirely for trivially small inputs.
